test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of different types of juices containing different fruit flavours which are manufactured by a juice company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75a4f3ffde7fc91f3afe23afb227558fdc064e28c7b9fe3cdbaeefb9c1b1aad8.png] 

How many types of juices does the company make that contain both Apple and Strawberry flavours?
solution:
• The shaded part represents types of juices does the company make that contain both Apple and Strawberry flavours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcd3b641de16e1507730be3070a67c5a97023c344936ca9ccfa36d529270a28e.png] 

 
• The number representing types of juices does the company make that contain both Apple and Strawberry flavours = 10 + 8 = 18

**Hence, ‘18’ is the correct answer.**
